$$ \rho_p(K) = \sup_{x \in \mathbb{R}^3} \limsup_{r \to 0} \frac{|B_r(x) \cap K|_p}{r^p} $$
where $| \cdot |_p$ denotes some norm or measure related to $p$, or more commonly in knot theory literature (e.g., related to the work of Cantarella, Kusner, Lutz, or specific density definitions in geometric topology), it refers to the supremum of the $L^p$ norm of the curvature or similar local geometric features normalized by scale.
